title: HazardEvent
description: Canonical data model for disaster and hazard events ingested by the Aggregator service. Fields are classified into Summary (Ringkasan - accessible by Media clients) and Raw (Mentah - accessible only by higher-tier clients, rejected with 403 Forbidden for Media clients).

hazard_id.description: [Summary Field / Ringkasan - Accessible by Media] Globally unique identifier for the hazard event generated by the Aggregator (e.g. UUIDv4 or structured ID).

source.description: [Summary Field / Ringkasan - Accessible by Media] Ingestion source agency reporting the event.

source_ref_id.description: [Raw Field / Mentah - Rejected with 403 for Media] Native reference or event ID from the source agency upstream system.

hazard_type.description: [Summary Field / Ringkasan - Accessible by Media] Type and domain classification of the natural hazard.

severity.description: [Summary Field / Ringkasan - Accessible by Media] Standardized national hazard alert severity level.

area_name.description: [Summary Field / Ringkasan - Accessible by Media] Human-readable descriptive name of the affected geographic area or volcano.

latitude.description: [Raw Field / Mentah - Rejected with 403 for Media] Geographic latitude coordinate in WGS84 decimal degrees (-90.0 to 90.0).

longitude.description: [Raw Field / Mentah - Rejected with 403 for Media] Geographic longitude coordinate in WGS84 decimal degrees (-180.0 to 180.0).

attributes.description: [Raw Field / Mentah - Rejected with 403 for Media] Dynamic JSON payload containing source-specific attributes mapped per official IF4031 M1 rules. Dynamic additionalProperties permitted for non-breaking schema evolution.

magnitude.description: Earthquake magnitude on Mw scale (BMKG seismic).

depth_km.description: Hypocenter focal depth in kilometers (BMKG seismic).

potential_tsunami.description: Tsunami potential indicator from BMKG seismic feed.

tsunami_warning.description: Correlated tsunami advisory details if warning was issued by BMKG.

volcano_id.description: Upstream volcano reference ID from PVMBG (e.g. VLC-001).

eruption_count_24h.description: Eruption count in last 24 hours from PVMBG volcanic feed.

ash_column_height_m.description: Ash column height in meters from PVMBG volcanic feed.

confidence_level.description: Dynamic confidence score [0.0 - 1.0] introduced at runtime by PVMBG via /admin/schema-version.

occurred_at.description: [Summary Field / Ringkasan - Accessible by Media] ISO 8601 UTC timestamp indicating when the hazard event occurred or was observed.

ingested_at.description: [Summary Field / Ringkasan - Accessible by Media] ISO 8601 UTC timestamp indicating when the record was ingested and persisted by the Aggregator.
